question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e. **'simultaneous'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is **'Simultaneous'.**
 
• **Simultaneous:** Occurring, existing, or done at the same time; concurrent. (दो या अधिक वस्‍तुओं का ठीक एक ही समय घटित होने या किया जाने वाला; समकालिक)
 
 
• **For example: **The team members made simultaneous presentations during the conference.
 
 

*Therefore the correct answer is 'simultaneous'.*
